cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(blockchain_nano VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(OpenSSL 3.0 REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
# Homebrew keeps ICU keg-only on macOS; retain normal system discovery elsewhere.
if(APPLE AND NOT ICU_ROOT)
 foreach(ICU_PREFIX /opt/homebrew/opt/icu4c /usr/local/opt/icu4c)
  if(EXISTS "${ICU_PREFIX}/include/unicode/unorm2.h")
   set(ICU_ROOT "${ICU_PREFIX}")
   break()
  endif()
 endforeach()
endif()
find_package(ICU REQUIRED COMPONENTS uc)
find_path(BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR boost/beast.hpp REQUIRED)
find_path(ROCKSDB_INCLUDE_DIR rocksdb/db.h REQUIRED)
find_library(ROCKSDB_LIBRARY rocksdb REQUIRED)
find_path(GMP_INCLUDE_DIR gmpxx.h REQUIRED)
find_library(GMP_LIBRARY gmp REQUIRED)
find_library(GMPXX_LIBRARY gmpxx REQUIRED)
file(GLOB NANO_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp)
list(FILTER NANO_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/main.cpp$")
add_subdirectory(third_party/ckzg)
include(cmake/NanoSecp256k1.cmake)
add_library(nano_core ${NANO_SOURCES})
target_link_libraries(nano_core PRIVATE nano_ckzg secp256k1)
target_include_directories(nano_core PUBLIC include third_party)
target_include_directories(nano_core SYSTEM PUBLIC ${GMP_INCLUDE_DIR} ${ROCKSDB_INCLUDE_DIR} ${BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(nano_core PUBLIC ${GMPXX_LIBRARY} ${GMP_LIBRARY} OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto ICU::uc ${ROCKSDB_LIBRARY} Threads::Threads)
target_compile_options(nano_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)

add_executable(nano-capella-duty-readiness tools/storage-maintenance/duty-readiness.cpp)
target_link_libraries(nano-capella-duty-readiness PRIVATE nano_core)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_NO_PACKAGE_REGISTRY ON)
set(NANO_MCL_PORTABLE_DEFAULT OFF)
if(UNIX)
 set(NANO_MCL_PORTABLE_DEFAULT ON)
endif()
option(MCL_PORTABLE "Use portable LLVM BN128 arithmetic without an ADX/JIT requirement" ${NANO_MCL_PORTABLE_DEFAULT})
add_subdirectory(third_party/mcl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
target_link_libraries(nano_core PUBLIC mcl::mcl_st)

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
 add_library(nano-test-sync-fault SHARED tests/support/sync_fault_linux.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(nano-test-sync-fault PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()

if(APPLE)
 add_library(nano-test-sync-fault SHARED tests/support/sync_fault_macos.cpp)
endif()

add_executable(nano-capella-transition-tests tests/test_capella_transition.cpp)
target_link_libraries(nano-capella-transition-tests PRIVATE nano_core nano_ckzg)
if(TARGET nano-test-sync-fault)
 target_link_libraries(nano-capella-transition-tests PRIVATE nano-test-sync-fault)
 target_compile_definitions(nano-capella-transition-tests PRIVATE NANO_SYNC_FAULT=1)
 add_test(NAME consensus_capella_queued_exit_sync COMMAND nano-capella-transition-tests --queued-exit-sync)
 set_tests_properties(consensus_capella_queued_exit_sync PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120 LABELS "qualification_consensus_recovery")
 add_test(NAME consensus_capella_queued_bls_sync COMMAND nano-capella-transition-tests --queued-bls-sync)
 set_tests_properties(consensus_capella_queued_bls_sync PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120 LABELS "qualification_consensus_recovery")
 add_test(NAME consensus_capella_reactor_sync_failure COMMAND nano-capella-transition-tests --reactor-sync)
 set_tests_properties(consensus_capella_reactor_sync_failure PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120 LABELS "qualification_consensus_ethereum")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(nano-capella-transition-tests PRIVATE NANO_TEST_SOURCE="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

add_executable(nano-p2p main.cpp)
target_include_directories(nano-p2p PRIVATE ../third_party)
target_compile_definitions(nano-p2p PRIVATE FMT_CONSTEVAL=)
target_link_libraries(nano-p2p PRIVATE p2p::p2p)
